summary.text: Michelle Teska is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 55 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. A sales manager by profession, she is vice chair of the Public Insurance and Pensions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Teska, listed by Ballotpedia as C. Michelle Teska, earned a B.S. in communication and media studies from the University of Dayton.
Her career experience includes working as a sales manager.
She won the 2024 Republican primary for District 55 over Ben McCullough and defeated Laura Marie Davis in the general election.
In the 2025–2026 session Teska was assigned to the Community Revitalization, Financial Institutions, Public Insurance and Pensions (vice chair) and Small Business committees.
